name: 💎⛏️ Lootin'
desc:
💎 Lootin' – Smash Rocks. Get Rich. 💎

Grab your pickaxe and dive into a world packed with secrets and treasure!

⛏️ What To Do
• Mine Rocks for coins, gems, and legendary finds
• Stack Luck & Upgrades to boost drop rates
• Complete Quests and unlock new worlds
• Discover Hidden Mysteries waiting deep underground
